scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:server & pnpm run dev:desktop & pnpm run dev:document & wait
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm --filter @synapse/shared run build && pnpm --filter @synapse/desktop run dev
scripts.dev:server: pnpm --filter @synapse/shared run build && docker compose --env-file server/.env.local -f server/compose.yml up -d postgres && (node scripts/dev/run-server-with-env.mjs --filter @synapse/server run dev & (node scripts/dev/wait-for-http.mjs http://127.0.0.1:${SYNAPSE_SERVER_API_PORT:-3001}/healthz --timeout-ms 60000 && node scripts/dev/run-server-with-env.mjs --filter @synapse/dashboard run dev) & wait)
scripts.quit:server: node scripts/dev/quit-processes.mjs dev:server && APP_PUBLIC_URL=${APP_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:3000} docker compose --env-file server/.env.local -f server/compose.yml down
